**{{< meta profile.role >}}** · {{< meta profile.affiliation >}}

I am a PhD student at the Conservatoire national des arts et métiers (CNAM), working at the intersection of artificial intelligence, machine learning, and knowledge representation.

My research focuses on extracting interpretable knowledge from complex and incomplete data, with particular interest in knowledge graphs and decision-support systems.

Previously, I studied mathematics and artificial intelligence at École normale supérieure de Lyon.

This website collects a short [research overview](research.qmd) and my [publications](publications.qmd).
